name: IELTS Platform
summary: Lets students practise IELTS reading, listening, writing and speaking online, and lets teachers manage tests and follow each student's progress.
problem: IELTS coaching centres often run mock tests on paper, which takes hours to mark and makes it hard to see where each student needs more practice.

features.title: Practice tests
features.description: Reading, listening, writing and speaking practice in the real test format.

features.title: Progress tracking
features.description: Scores and progress for each student, by module.

features.title: Teacher tools
features.description: Create tests, review answers and give feedback in one place.

audience: Students preparing for IELTS on their own
